04 / CRM Solutions

Every lead, conversation and follow-up in one place your team will actually use.

CRM implementation, customisation, automation and migration, so leads are organised, follow-ups happen and customer history is never lost.

Discuss this serviceSee what is included

The situation

Leads arrive by phone, email, web form and referral, and without a shared system they live in individual inboxes and notebooks. Follow-ups slip, and nobody can say with confidence what is in the pipeline.

A CRM fixes that only if it matches how your team sells and supports. We configure the system around your stages, your language and your reporting needs, then connect it to the tools around it.

Capabilities

What this service covers.

  • 01

    CRM implementation and customization

    Selecting and configuring a CRM platform around your sales and service process, or building a custom one where that fits better.

    • Requirements and platform selection
    • Fields, stages and permissions
    • User training

  • 02

    Lead and sales pipeline management

    A clear view of every opportunity: where it came from, who owns it and what happens next.

    • Lead capture from all channels
    • Assignment and routing rules
    • Pipeline stages and forecasting views

  • 03

    Customer lifecycle workflows

    Defined steps from first enquiry through onboarding, renewal and repeat business.

    • Onboarding checklists
    • Renewal and review reminders
    • Hand-offs between teams

  • 04

    Sales and marketing automation

    Timely, consistent follow-up without relying on someone to remember.

    • Follow-up sequences and tasks
    • Segmented campaigns
    • Lead scoring rules

  • 05

    Customer support workflows

    Support requests tracked against the customer record, with ownership and response targets.

    • Ticket intake and routing
    • Escalation rules
    • Shared customer history

  • 06

    Reporting and analytics

    Dashboards built on questions the business needs answered, not on whatever the default template shows.

    • Pipeline and activity reports
    • Source and conversion tracking
    • Scheduled summaries

  • 07

    CRM migration and integrations

    Moving from spreadsheets or an older CRM, and connecting the new one to the rest of your stack.

    • Data cleaning and migration
    • Email, telephony and website integration
    • Accounting and ERP sync

Delivery

From discovery through deployment and support.

Every engagement follows the same six stages, scaled to the size of the work.

  1. 01

    Discover

    Discovery and requirements.

  2. 02

    Design

    Solution design and planning.

  3. 03

    Build

    Development and implementation.

  4. 04

    Test

    Testing and quality assurance.

  5. 05

    Launch

    Deployment and handover.

  6. 06

    Support

    Ongoing support and optimization.

What you leave with

  • A configured CRM that mirrors your process
  • Clean, migrated customer data
  • A team trained to use it day to day
